Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in genealogical reasoning by misidentifying the relationship hierarchy. In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather of Charles Bretagne Marie de La Tr moille (the 9th Duke) was the 6th Duke (Charles Louis Bretagne de La Tr moille). The logic chain was flawed: the Planner identified the 7th Duke (Charles Armand Ren  de La Tr moille) as the father of the 8th Duke (Charles Godefroy), which is correct. However, the Planner then erroneously assumed the 6th Duke was the father of the 7th Duke and thus the grandfather of the 9th Duke. In reality, the 7th Duke (Charles Armand Ren  de La Tr moille) is the father of the 8th Duke, making the 7th Duke the **paternal grandfather** of the 9th Duke. The 6th Duke is the great-grandfather. The Planner failed to correctly map the "father of the father" relationship, confusing the 6th Duke (great-grandfather) with the 7th Duke (grandfather).
